sources.name: GaneshaSpeaks
sources.text: It will be a thought-provoking day with titbits of success and rewards scattered here and there, says Ganesha. If you feel you got the short end of the stick, do not let it affect your morale. Every sunrise comes with a different promise and today is not the end of the world. There are strong indications that planetary movements will change things for the better from tomorrow, says Ganesha.

sources.name: Horoscope.com
sources.text: Things should be going quite well for you today, Taurus, and you will find that aspects of your life that may have felt disconnected in the past are finally slipping into place. Have faith that all your painstaking planning and organizing is finally going to pay off.

sources.name: Astrology.com
sources.text: Blessings are bestowed upon your family and household early this morning, darling Taurus. The warming Leo Moon and Jupiter unite to elevate your space and those you cherish most. This celestial union also refreshes connections that have gone a bit stale. Luna aspects the Nodes of Fate and Chiron while making her way into Virgo this evening, encouraging you to enjoy some alone time before connecting with others.

sources.name: AstroSage
sources.text: Your anger could create a mountain out of molehill-which would only upset your family members. Fortunate indeed are those great souls whose intelligence keeps anger under control. Burn your anger before it burns you. If you work or study by staying away from home, then learn to stay away from such people who waste your money and time. Make sure you have approval of everyone before you make changes to your home environment. Exercise caution- wisdom and patience while dealing with people at work. You should try to understand the things in the right manner, otherwise you'll waste your free time just thinking about such scenarios continuously. You and your spouse might get a wonderful news today.

readings.text: Keeping a pen and paper with you will be a clever idea as today you will experience a huge influx of creative ideas that it will be hard to remember unless you jot them down. You will handle tasks well, provided your thoughts and action are in sync.

The people you communicate with today will be very beneficial to your career, even if these conversations aren't happening in any sort of work-related context. By just being yourself, you will automatically draw lucky and supportive people to your side.

bits.t: If you work or study by staying away from home, then learn to stay away from such people who waste your money and time.
Exercise caution- wisdom and patience while dealing with people at work.

readings.text: Ganesha feels that you will be thinking more about money matters today that earlier. You will be circumspect but there will be conflict between emotion and logic when it comes to financial affairs.

You may need to reconsider recent financial plans. Your head is full of all kinds of amazingly creative ideas. If you're a writer, journalist, or publisher, this is a great time to be you. But you need to use these gifts in a responsible way. Make sure you're saving your money with a reliable company.

bits.t: If you work or study by staying away from home, then learn to stay away from such people who waste your money and time.
Exercise caution- wisdom and patience while dealing with people at work.

readings.text: Today your health will remain good. You may think of doing creative activities. Doing such work will probably make you feel much better. As you will be in good health, you will be able to handle your activities pretty well.

The aspect of the day gives you the chance to dream big - dreams that you can actually achieve, too! With your knack for realism and focus on the future you will be able to put your money where your mouth is in no time. Start with today and do for your body what you can including drinking lots of water and making healthy choices when you eat. At the same time, envision a healthy future and plan accordingly!

bits.t: Exercise caution- wisdom and patience while dealing with people at work.

lucky.remedy: Regular intake of Tulsi leaves will be greatly auspicious for health.

extras.title: Bonus
extras.text: An arrangement you've been counting on may be dissolving -- think up a backup plan.
